UK Judge Dismisses Prince Harry's Case Against Daily Mail

A UK judge has dismissed the case filed by Prince Harry and other prominent figures against the Daily Mail publisher, citing insufficient proof of wrongdoing in their alleged unlawful information-gathering methods. The claimants now face a significant legal bill.
